# IdeToolRailMode

`Flare.Components.IDE.IdeToolRailMode`

How the rail of a collapsed or auto-hidden side region lists its tools in a FlareIdeLayout.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Region` | `0` | One button for the whole region: it labels every hosted tool and expands the region. This is the default and the behavior every consumer had before the option existed. |
| `PerTool` | `1` | One entry per hosted tool in an auto-hide side region, with the tool's icon and rotated label. Selecting an entry opens that tool in the region's flyout; the active tool is marked and selecting it again closes the flyout. Regions in the docked mode, the bottom region and regions without a hosted tool group keep the region button. |

## Used by components

- `FlareIdeLayout`
